pages.transcription:
Dear Hannah & Manfred, so many thanks for your kind wishes
10.XI.41.
PETROPOLIS, (BRASIL)
(34, RUA GONÇALVES DIAS)
- You are quite right that they find me in a
melancholic mood. All hopes for a short end of this war would
be foolish and you will understand that my special situation is not favorable. We
have no ~~publisher~~ {editor} for the original version of the books, France, Italy and most
other countries are lost, the United States are not my line of writing and it has not
much sense to contribute for magazines with a deduction of 27 % at the source
10 % for the agent and a fee for the translator. My Balzac can not be finished
here without a large documentation; thanks God the autobiography is at least
ready but when will she be translated and how - all the Harass, the tempo
the colour is gone. And I have started already new work our life is at least
here so easy, let us describe our day; morning a delicious Brazilian coffee,
then on the veranda work and reading, a primitive lunch, a game of chess,
a walk and work again - we spend nearly nothing, I have not been in a theatre
since a year, in a concert since half a year, but I see strictly nobody for weeks, but
the surroundings are marvellous, the climate agreable, it is a monkish life but a
very healthy one and this was necessary. I must confess that I had a break down
with black thoughts that all may happen (and some of it may happen/ Lotte was
only bones and cough for weeks; now I feel more indifferent against all possible
annoyances and worries and she looks much better, we live together like turtle-
doves and try to forget the world and I wish the whole world shall forget us. All my efforts
to learn Portugese are in vain and I cannot adapt myself to America - much
better to Brasil and the English countries. - As to Eva do not worry. There has been
some disorder by taking over the new house, Mrs Schaeffer who loves Eva like a mother
has financial and domestic difficulties and furthermore broken her arm; so she
was perhaps a few days not able to give all her love and nerves, but it seems to be
allright now. You know how we would have liked to take Eva with us but with our
dull life here in the mountains she would have been unhappy. - I am so sorry
for Edomaren and much more because I have gone through the same desperate
mood myself, And I know how his brother expects him and would do everything
for him! Please do not worry about the house, do not loose your time with my
damned things, I hate the idea that you feel the responsibility for the upkeep
and I am afraid that you will be paid only with worries and difficulties. Let
things go easy, you have to do enough to make dear Manfred life as happy as
possible - "mit fab meine Sach' auf nichts gestellt" how the old song says and I am sure
pages.notes: Brief auf Briefpapier mit gedrucktem Briefkopf. Handschrift in violetter Tinte. Am rechten Rand vertikal geschriebener Text: 'I shall be right in the long run. I hope you had forged you own expenses for bath and I have had I nevertheless will be in moral and material debt to you. Kindest regards to all and love from Stefan'.
